name: Roulette
summary: Bet color, parity, or a number. Safer bets pay less. A last-ditch double is red or black, not a single number.
achievements: All on Red, Ball in Motion

name: Wheel of Fortune
summary: A different machine from the Money Wheel. Guides treat small repeated bets as the sane use, and say wheels do not replay on reload.
achievements: Spin The Wheel, Keep It Spinning, Lucky Streak (Floor 1 route)

name: Blackjack
summary: Beat the dealer without passing 21. Card order is the usual reload target: the same hands come back if you quit before the day resolves.
achievements: Risky Move, No Bust Run, House Breaker

name: Slots
summary: Fast spins. Useful when a Holy Statue window is already running, because you can get several bets in before it ends.

name: Street Craps
summary: Floor 1’s Lucky 7 is the first roll, and only a 7. Floor 3’s Natural Roller is a win during the point phase. The “infinite money” reputation is the reload trick, not the table’s odds.

name: Duck Race
summary: Pick a duck. Community save-scum notes treat the winner as something you can learn with a small bet and a reload.

name: Crash
summary: Cash out before the rocket dies. V1.0.30 tweaked Crash payouts and fixed a client screen that could stick. A cautious cash-out around 1.5x is the community habit, not a rule.

name: Plinko
summary: A peg board. Reloading does not repeat the path. For Clean Fall, players lightly throw a baseball bat (Q) at the middle pin of the third row so balls shed toward the 24x cups. It is an assist, not a promise.

name: Penguin Cross
summary: Step the penguin forward and cash the multiplier before traffic gets it. Further is richer and more likely to zero the bet.
achievements: Winner Winner Penguin Dinner, Traffic Monster, No Hesitation

name: Keno
summary: Pick tiles, then see which ones hit. Guides say the board is random and that chasing last round’s tiles does not help.

name: HiLo
summary: Call the next card higher or lower. Floor achievements that cite HiLo line up with Steam ids named DICE, so the exact table label is slightly fuzzy.
achievements: Roll the Odds, No Safe Rolls

name: Money Wheel
summary: Pick a color that maps to a multiplier. Not the Wheel of Fortune. Wheels are in the “reload will not help” group.

name: 1P Poker
summary: A solo poker draw. Lock cards you want to keep, then draw. V1.0.30 fixed a duplicate-card bug. Poker Face wants you not to lock anything.

name: Dragon Tower
summary: Climb tiles and avoid the dragon eyes. Community routes memorize a path with a small bet, then reload. Same path, same tiles.

name: Mine Sweeper
summary: The Steam 100% guide’s worked example: bombs you already hit come back after a quit-and-reload, so the next attempt can avoid them.

name: Baccarat
summary: Bet which side gets closer to 9, or bet a tie. V1.0.30 changed its payouts. Which floor deals it was not pinned down in the sources checked here.

name: 17th game — name not confirmed
summary: The Steam store says 17 games of chance. The 16 names above are the ones public guides agree on. The missing name is left blank on purpose.
